ratings.comment: Not an easy class, especially if you haven't taken AP Calc in high school.  I spent a TON of time in my TA's office hours and did Math tutorial (which didn't help at all) She commonly makes mistakes on her own examples, making the material ten times more confusing.  The class is do-able if you are willing to put in the time.

She is a terrible instructor. The most frequently used words in her lectures were "um", "uh", "hm", and "ambiguous". I actually walked out of class on numerous occassions because its such a pet peeve of mine. In her defense, tests were pretty fair and i got a B- because i didn't turn in hw or do well on quizzes.

This was adifficult class, and her inability to explain clear examples made it even more difficult.  She has good intentions and would be a cool neighbor, but as a professor she just didn't really cut it.  She makes many mistakes in class and was late honestly every lecture and then kept us late which is annoying.Overall, tough lecture to deal with
She is an ok professor. The main problem is she seems to teach the class as if you have already taken calculus 221 before. She also messes up things in lecture from time to time.

Nice prof, really helpful during office hours.  Usually comes in late to lecture which can get annoying, but she generally knows her stuff and teaches it well with a lot of examples and well-written theorems.

Late almost every day. Unacceptable number of mistakes during lecture. Completely absurd grading and she sometimes wears shirts that are see-through (ew). A nice, well intentioned person, but definitely the worst professor I have ever had.
She's constantly late with very lame excuses. Plus, do not expect little work in this class if you want to get an A. The exam is fair, and highly identical to the questions on the review sheet.
She reminds me of my mom, which is terrible.

Her power lectures seemed to drag on forever and here excessive number of mistakes didn't help. While she does curve her exams, they are still really hard. I would have to say that she is one of the worst professors I have had thus far.
Makes a lot of mistakes during lecture. Her exams are hard but there is a major curve at the end of the semester so don't fret. The quality of your TA will pretty much make or break your experience.
Great teacher, explains things very well and goes through lots of examples.  Tests are hard but if you are usually an A student in math you will get an A.
Very annoying voice.  Difficult exams that are harder than the practice exams.  The power lecture she taught seemed like it lasted forever.

The class was decent. I didn't take calc in high school so it took me a bit to get the hang of it. MY TA ROCKED! he was the cutest little asian man. She's better than some profs i know of (mari-beffa YIKES! don't take her) Exams were fairly decent. I'd probably take her again.

Professor Gomez is the best Math teacher I've ever had. Her lectures are very helpful and I would take her again. I think the students that complain are just lazy and don't understand that you actually have to work for a decent grade.

If you havent takin Calc in High School this class will be hard.  she teaches very SLOW and most of the time no one knos WTF is going on.  He teaches to the board and makes a lot of mistakes.  I didnt like her.

She gives WAY too much homework and her lectures are borderline useless.  Can't explain things clearly, and has a hard time not messing up at least 3 or 4 times a lecture. Loves sending out e-mails complaining about our questions. Exams are fair and usually have problems identical to review/hw problems. Do the assigned work and you'll be fine.
She is a very bad teacher. I leave class more confused most of the time. I plan to be an engineer and her math class made me dislike math

Horrible teacher. Lectures are just her copying her notes onto the board and she gets it wrong half the time. tests are WAY harder than the examples she does so they surprise you. lecture is so boring it is hard to sit through. Her explanations are so unnecessarily complicated and she does not give steps to do problems, just examples DONT TAKE HER

Worst teacher ever, not sure how she has a Phd in math she can't even explain problems from the sheet she copies her notes from onto the board. Lecture is just a reading of the textbook, doesn't do much to explain things beyond what the book does. Exams are hard and graded strictly. Tons of things to memorize for each exam
No Comments

I have a love/hate relationship with Concha.  I felt she taught the material well and was nice in lecture. On the other hand she makes a lot of mistakes on problems and blames it on being tired and will stop class to identify a sneezer or someone whose phone is ringing (who cares?).  Exams are fair if you do the assignments, reviews, & past exams!

Very boring class (the material makes it that way). Professor is not very approachable and the tests are very difficult. If you're struggling early on...drop it. TA's don't speak very good english and are borderline useless. Good luck

Boring lectures, but I won't hold the subject against her. Gives insane amounts of homework and doesn't do difficult examples, tests are difficult. And if more than a few people complain about something she writes an email to everyone in the class to tell us we're wrong.
Very clear and fair, take her for Math 222 if u can.
I've taken other calc professors and the way she explains things is 10x better.  I would definitly recommend taking her.

Gomez is a VERY GOOD TEACHER as far as math profs go. She doesn't waste time on stupid proofs like the foreign guys, and exams are not too hard - straight forward and on the material covered. She even made  Taylor series easy to learn. She can be condecending toward students. It's funny when she wears all black and smears chalk all over herself.

Worst professor I've ever had in my life...she's unhelpful, doesn't know what she's teaching, but still expects us to know it. Exams are ridiculously hard. She's lazy, and doesn't put much effort into the class

She isnt very helpful at all and she really treats it like a high school class. She actually stops lecture if she hears someone talking. The tests arent that hard. The other thing about her is if she knows you and likes you, you're guaranteed a good grade. If she doesnt know you or doesnt like you, study hard because an A will be hard to get.
She was an okay professor in lecture but her tests are VERY fair, you get review packets for every test and if you know the stuff on those and do your homework you will ace the tests

Best prof. I have had at UW.  Lectures easy to understand if you overview the sections before class.  Tests are very fair, and if you do the homework and go to class you will do well.  She does make some small errors, but she corrects them immediatly.  For exams, understand every section and all the concepts well and you will do well. Overall great
Terrible Lecturer...not interesting

Don't listen to the other people on this board.  Yeah she messes up in lecture, but she is very clear. She's not like other math professors who just speed through and write down a bunch of stuff no one understands.  Everyone I know that said she sucked who is now taking a math course with a diff. prof. and they miss her.  Her tests aren't hard.

Most of the time she doesn't know what she is talking about-expect at least two mistakes per lecture. The exams are pretty easy though just do the homework and you'll do fine, if you go in for help she probably won't be of any help. Expect only to get help from your TA.

She was the worst professor ever. Most of the time in her lectures people would start laughing because no one had any idea what she was talking about. Don't even bother studying for her tests because 1/2 the stuff on them we never cover, but she seems to think we do.

Awesome professor. Go to her office hours; it will clear-up any problems you have. Extremely helpful and careful in her explanations. Tests are not easy, but nothing on them is ever a surprise.  Seriously, if you need to really learn linear algebra, then you would be a fool not to take it with this professor.
She is a rather good calc prof considering some of the others out there.  If you go to her office hours it can clear up any confusion from lecture, she is very helpful.

She makes daily mistakes in lecture and blames them repeatedly on having a cold. Don't make any noise in lcture or else she'll stop the class and ask what you are talking about as if it were a high school class.  She gets very defensive about it since she knows people are talking about her mistakes
She seems like she feels that she's too good to teach that low of a level of math. She gets flustered easily.

She is a nice person, but that is about it.  She isn't that bad of a lecturer, but gets mixed up even though she is holding her notes in her hand.  Only has around 3 outfits she wears to class, and is kind of boring.  But she seems like a nice person. If she is sick you won't get any help from her.

She makes a lot of mistakes and makes the class seem easy when its not, and then hard when its supposed to be easy.  Expects a lot on her exams, beware.  Survivable but not easy, and you really need to go to class to be successful.
No Comments
she is an ok lecturer, she could vary the wardrobe, you know move on from black to pastel. If you have not taken calc before, beware, many other students have which throws off the curve signifigantly

She isn't a very good lecturer, but she is very helpful when you are confused after lectures.  She makes mistakes, and is kind of confusing when explaining how to complete a problem. But if you do the homework and actually figure out how to do everything, the tests are not bad at all.

I didnt like her very much, she speaks extremely slowly and doesn't seem to know what she is doing herself. Although she is a nice person she expects too much from students and does not teach very well.  She doesn't explain things well but if you have already taken stuff in this class you will do ok

She's a really great prof when you get right down to it. She knows what she's doing and will ask enough interactive questions in class to make sure you do too. It's good to learn it well the first time, especially if you've got a crappy TA. Take her if you can! (She sounds like Ellen DeGeneres).
Easy class.  If you've taken trig or calc in high school don't bother coming to lectures.  Explains things well and is always willing to help.

very clear in lectures, speaks slowly, but it is helpful if you need to learn what she's saying..allows time for stuff to sink in, and if you already know what she's talking about, at least there's comfortable chairs :), makes some mistakes on board but at least sheadmits them, exams not bad at all
